license: CC BY-SA 4.0 as listed by BeIR dataset card
method: internal retrieval pipeline, not HTTP; rank first 10 chunks then deduplicate documents, evaluate document qrels
limitations: The evaluator is a temporary adapter and is not the official BEIR evaluator.
The test ranks chunks, cuts to 10, then deduplicates document IDs before scoring document-level relevance.
Index time excludes model loading, chunk creation, HTTP uploads, PostgreSQL, and original-file storage; vectors are computed across documents in batches.
Search timings measure the retrieval components directly and exclude HTTP, authentication, PostgreSQL validation, and response serialization.
Concurrency uses an in-process model lock and 12 queries per level; it does not measure the HTTP service.
The corpus and queries are English; BM25 uses the current Spanish configuration.
